Spider Solitaire · Objective-C → Unity port

iPad — Unity Port Fidelity

Unity 8.0.0  vs  Obj-C 7.42.5  ·  1620×2160  ·  15 screens  ·  iPad (9th gen)  ·  build 337

Build 337 on iPad clears most of the earlier layout drift — the Choose-Look modal is positioned correctly again, the main-menu promo strip is back, the difficulty smiley cursor returns, and the victory buttons are red. It is still not pixel-faithful though: two content bugs remain — the FAQ duplicates its first question and a “Dev Panel” debug button ships on the win screen — plus systemic typography drift and dropped ad banners. Drag any image to wipe between the builds; switch to Diff for the exact changed pixels (red).

Findings · triage

Grouped for the porting team, most actionable first.

  • Content bug
    FAQ duplicates its first questionFAQ

    The FAQ now shows Spider’s own content (build 335’s “wrong game” Klondike text is fixed), but the first entry — “How do I play the game?” — renders twice, back-to-back, identical.

  • Content bug
    “Dev Panel” debug button ships on the win screenVictory · Best

    Victory · Best shows a “Dev Panel” button at the bottom-right — a development-only control that should not be present in a shipping build.

  • Layout drift
    In-game menu tray still differsIn-Game Menu

    On the In-Game Menu, the bottom tray (replay / abandon / options / …) renders with different wood/button styling and Unity drops the ad banner there — the largest remaining diff.

  • Layout drift
    Typography & content deltassystemic

    Unity sets body text heavier and wraps it differently (Help / Options / FAQ). Also: lowercase “options” title; More Games lists extra titles and shifts layout; Stats markers “*” vs “✻” with lowercase headers; the Game Table / In-Game Menu drop the bottom ad banner.

  • Correct
    Fixed since build 335regression check

    Several earlier iPad defects are resolved: the main-menu promo-icon strip is back; the Choose-Look modal is correctly positioned again (was shifted & enlarged); Difficulty’s smiley cursor returns and its stray entries are gone; the victory buttons are red again and Victory · Score no longer shows a promo strip; the FAQ loads Spider’s own content.

  • Correct
    Still correct on iPadAbout · Help · Cards

    About keeps its “▷” divider and correct “submit feedback”; Help shows a single “Introduction”; Choose Look · Cards reads “symbols”.
